text:
alex: heads-up — found a permissive ClusterRoleBinding that allows `deploy-sa` to impersonate SAs in the gpu-pool namespace. KMS decrypt activity spiked at 11:42 UTC. can we triage?

priya: can you paste the binding & a snippet of the audit log?

alex: here's the binding:
```
kubectl get clusterrolebinding deploy-sa-binding -o yaml
subjects:
- kind: ServiceAccount
  name: deploy-sa
  namespace: ci
roleRef:
  kind: ClusterRole
  name: gpu-access
```
and audit: `{"verb":"impersonate","resource":"serviceaccounts","user":"system:serviceaccount:ci:deploy-sa","ts":"2024-10-03T11:42:12Z"}`

jordan: was this from the new deploy pipeline? saw CI job #4589 used deploy-sa token around that time.

alex: yes, job 4589. long-lived token was mounted by mistake after the helm chart refactor.

sam: mitigation: remove the ClusterRoleBinding immediately, rotate any KMS keys used by the pipeline, and revoke the CI token. commands:
```
kubectl delete clusterrolebinding deploy-sa-binding
gcloud kms keys versions destroy --location=global --keyring=ci --key=deploy-key --version=2
```

eng-oncall-bot: alert — KMS decrypts increased 7x in 5m for key projects/ci/keys/deploy-key :warning:

priya: after we mitigate we should harden: replace cluster-wide binding with namespace-scoped role, switch CI to short-lived Workload Identity tokens, and enable audit export to SIEM. I'll open a PR for the RBAC change.

alex: agreed. I'll revoke the token and start KMS rotation now. we also need a one-pager for infra SOC: timeline + affected resources.

jordan: I'll own the postmortem and playbook. target EOD tomorrow for initial write-up. assigning to @jordan.

sam: FYI add an automated test in the helm charts to fail if clusterrolebinding is created for deploy-sa :thumbsup:
